title: Conductor
description: What the conductor's hands did, as the score service read them.

list.name: job
list.label: Score service
list.description: score: the one the headset conducts (127.0.0.1:8790); score-test: a test instance (127.0.0.1:8795)

panels.title: Status
panels.description: The take's status: idle, playing (a count-in too), stopped (stop.all) or ended.

panels.title: Bar
panels.description: The bar the music is at (during a count-in, the bar it starts at).

panels.title: Hands
panels.description: Dry run: Jev reads the hands, nothing is published.

panels.title: Readings per minute, by gesture
panels.description: Each hand Jev read, after the threshold (nothing included), per minute.

panels.title: Headset gestures per minute
panels.description: The headset's own gestures, read by the headset, not by Jev: taps, swipes, pinches, the double pinch, beats.

panels.title: Jev's latency
panels.description: How long Jev took to answer the service: posture (the hands) and expression (the motion).

panels.title: Under the threshold, per minute
panels.description: A gesture Jev chose with less than the threshold's probability: read as nothing.

panels.title: Jev's probability for the gesture read
Why nothing was sent
panels.description: In the time range: readings that sent nothing, and why.

panels.title: Levels: a flat hand's level is provisional until a double pinch keeps it
Levels pending, kept, reverted
panels.description: Each provisional level, and how it ended: kept (double pinch, pinch released) or reverted (why).

panels.title: Provisional and kept level per group
Double pinches
panels.description: Double pinches in the time range (each keeps the levels waiting).

panels.title: Gain per section (as it sounds)
panels.description: Each section's gain on its way to the one the conductor set, 0 to 1.

panels.title: Expression: chairs per character
panels.description: How many chairs play each character (the plain voice left out).

panels.title: Expression read per minute
panels.description: Jev's reading of the motion after the threshold (nothing included).

panels.title: Expression changes and publishes per minute
